technology_name: A CONTROLLING SYSTEM FOR SWIVELLING HEADLAMP AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Fixed vehicle headlights blind drivers oncoming in corners because the beam pattern remains completely locked straight, failing to illuminate blind curves ahead.
description: An automated optoelectronic controlling system containing an input sensor rig, an active swivelling actuator driver unit, and a localized controller module built to dynamically steer headlight optics matching the steering column's angle, featuring a straight-ahead failsafe backup matrix.
applications: Active cornering car headlight assemblies, autonomous delivery rover navigation beams, heavy machinery mining lamps, and emergency vehicle path illumination.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
